messages.text: Hi, I sent back the bath mat I bought last month. Can I get a refund?

tool_calls.name: propose_refund
tool_calls.arguments: {"order_id":"h11-o1","unit_ids":["h11-o1-u1"],"summary_for_staff":"Customer asks for a refund for the returned cotton bath mat."}

messages.name: propose_refund
messages.content: {"ok": true, "proposal_id": "prop-72104ff75e014c44", "status": "ineligible", "outcome": "refused", "amount_minor": null, "currency": "BRL", "policy_citations": ["refund-policy/v1/window"], "next_step": "Tell the customer it cannot be refunded and why, citing the sections given."}

messages.text: Sorry, I can’t refund the cotton bath mat because it falls outside the refund window (refund-policy/v1/window).
It’s only been a few hours since I found time to ask about the refund. I understand.

tool_calls.name: lookup_refund_policy
tool_calls.arguments: {"query":"refund request window measured from purchase, delivery, or return date; exceptions when customer only recently asks"}

messages.name: lookup_refund_policy
messages.content: {"ok": true, "sections": [{"citation": "refund-policy/v1/return", "title": "Items must be returned first", "text": "The shop refunds only units it has received back, as shown by its own return records, never by a statement of the customer or the assistant. If the records show the units arrived, the request continues normally. If they do not, the shop pays nothing for those units; if the customer says the units were already sent, a staff member checks."}, {"citation": "refund-policy/v1/exceptions", "title": "Exceptions and talking to a person", "text": "Anything this policy does not cover, and any request for an exception, goes to a staff member. The customer can ask for a person at any time."}, {"citation": "refund-policy/v1/eligible-orders", "title": "Which orders qualify", "text": "Only orders with the status \"delivered\" can receive a refund. An order that has not been delivered is not refunded through this process; if the customer reports a delivery that never arrived, a staff member takes the case. If a delivered order has no delivery time, or one that cannot be right (before the purchase or in the future), a staff member takes the case."}], "note": "Cite a section by its citation ID, exactly as given."}

A refund proposal was refused under refund-policy/v1/window.","decision_needed":"Review whether an exception to the refund window can be made."}

messages.name: request_handoff
messages.content: {"ok": true, "handoff_id": "hand-82a9ce512ec740af", "next_step": "Tell the customer a person will take over. Make no more changes."}

messages.text: I understand. The refund proposal was refused under the refund-window rule (refund-policy/v1/window). Since you’re asking about an exception, a person will take over to review it (refund-policy/v1/exceptions).
